description: This file defines the LabelFile class, which encapsulates information about a label file, including its associated file object and component name.

classes.name: LabelFile
classes.description: Represents a label file with its associated file object and component name.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the File object associated with this label file.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the name of the label file.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path of the label file.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns the component name associated with this label file.
